metadata.title: त्रिपुरा में टिपरा मोथा ने सड़क-रेल सब किया जाम | Tripura: Road and Rail shut down by Tipra Motha
metadata.description: Tipra Motha, the main opposition party in Tripura called for a 12-hour bandh in the state. The party workers blocked roads and railway tracks. Tipra Motha leaders claimed that the bandh was a success. Tipra Motha is demanding a separate tipraland state for the tribals of the state.
